text:
maria-support: FYI — acme-corp reporting a spike of 429s + >2s token latencies on their Dedicated pool. Customer says traffic should stay on their reserved pool but control plane routed a bunch to shared. Opening thread with logs + quick repro.

kevin-support: Oof, can you paste a request id + tenant id? I’ll loop in oncall.

maria-support: req=6f2a9b1f tenant=acme-42 — repro curl: 
```\ncurl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \\n  -H "X-Tenant-Group: gold-eu" \\n  -d '{"model":"rwd-neo-1","input":"hello"}'\n```

deploy-bot: control-plane:deploy succeeded (commit 9f3c2e1) — routing parser tweak rolled 2026-06-12T10:05Z to canary.

sam-oncall: tagging @raj-runtime. Customer impact live, marking high. Can we confirm if this aligns with the canary window?

raj-runtime: Looking. I see a cluster of routing_decision logs around req=6f2a9b1f: 
```\n{"req":"6f2a9b1f","tenant":"acme-42","incoming_header":"gold-eu","matched_rule":null,"fallback_pool":"shared-low","reason":"policy_nomatch"}\n```

olivia-enginfra: digging into the parser output — the canary changed tag matching to use a anchored regex that expects exact token boundaries. For tenants that send hyphenated groups (eg `gold-eu`) it fails to match `gold` rule and falls through to shared. Also noticed we previously tolerated commas/spaces; new patch treats header as single token without trimming.

kevin-support: so noisy neighbor effect = their reserved pool is skipped, requests hit shared pool which is token-throttled. Customer saw 429s.

raj-runtime: quick mitigation: pin tenant acme-42 to pool `dedicated-pool-42` via control-plane override (manual affinity) — I can apply now. Also rolling back canary to previous parser in canary hosts.

maria-support: please apply — customer is on a paid reserved contract.

raj-runtime: applied override and rolled canary back. Patch note: changed header canonicalization to split on `[ ,;]`, trim whitespace, and match by prefix (eg `/^gold(\b|[-_])/i`). PR created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4123

deploy-bot: control-plane:rollback started (commit 9f3c2e1) -> previous commit 7a1b0d4 successful on canary.

kevin-support: Customer confirmed errors drop to normal within ~90s, latency back to <200ms. :thumbsup:

maria-support: putting follow-up items here: 1) postmortem draft, 2) add unit tests for hyphenated tenant groups+comma header, 3) add temporary alert for sudden pool mismatch rate for reserved tenants.

sam-oncall: agreed. I'll create incident and assign owners. Tagging this as SOC-2026-072.

olivia-enginfra: note for engineer handoff — routing rules should prefer explicit reserved-pool affinity before regex matching; failing that, record a high-confidence telemetry event so support can auto-notify.

maria-support: closing loop with customer now, will attach logs and remediation steps. Thanks all.

kevin-support: adding a short support note to KB: "If dedicated tenant uses compound tag (eg gold-eu), ensure routing parser canonicalizes tags to match rule tokens."

raj-runtime: will merge PR after CI + add canary smoke that runs the curl above against canary candidates.

maria-support: resolved for now — re-open if we see a recurrence.
